company.shortDescription: Maison Privee is a hospitality technology company offering corporate and short-term vacation rental services.
company.description: Maison Privee is a Dubai-based hospitality technology company offering luxury vacation and corporate rentals with premium hotel-style services. It manages high-end apartments and villas across Dubai and Abu Dhabi, combining short-term rental management, concierge support, guest services, and property optimization. Maison Privee helps travelers enjoy luxury home experiences while enabling property owners to maximize rental income through flexible, tech-enabled property management solutions.
